allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp.summary: Allows the Claude in Chrome server to run together with a deployed managed-mcp.json.

allowedProviders.summary: Restricts which API providers a machine can use.

appendPlugins.summary: Runs your organisation's mods after each mod a user installs.

attribution.commit.summary: Modifies or removes the commit trailer that Claude Code appends.

attribution.pr.summary: Alters or removes the credit line shown in pull request descriptions.

attribution.sessionUrl.summary: Leave out the claude.ai session link in cloud plus Remote Control commits.

autoCompactWindow.summary: Sets the context fullness threshold before Claude Code compacts.

autoContinueAtUsageLimit.summary: Keep the session open and resume the task automatically when the claude.ai usage cap resets.

autoMode.classifyAllShell.summary: Sends all shell commands through the auto mode classifier, including those matched by a narrow allow rule.

availableModelsMatch.summary: Makes each availableModels model ID entry allow only the version it specifies.

bashEditDiffEnabled.summary: Logs which files changed during a Bash command in all permission modes.

bashOutputMaxChars.summary: Set the maximum characters of output from a successful command that Claude gets inline.

claudeInChromeDefaultEnabled.summary: Turns on Chrome integration when a session begins in both the interactive CLI and VS Code extension.

copyFullResponse.summary: Makes /copy copy the entire response without displaying the picker.

copyOnSelect.summary: Disables automatic copying of mouse-selected text in fullscreen rendering and agent view.

crossSessionInbound.summary: Decides whether Claude Code delivers other-session messages, just shows a notice, or refuses them.

defaultToAgentsView.summary: When you run claude without arguments, open agent view rather than a new conversation.

deniedModels.summary: Blocks specific models even if availableModels allows them.

desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays.summary: Sets how many days before transcripts from Claude Desktop and Cowork are cleaned up.

dialogExpiry.summary: Controls the timeout for Claude Code to receive a reply from a Remote Control or SDK host about a forwarded dialog, after which it cancels.

disableCommandPluginSources.summary: Blocks plugins that install by running a command declared by a marketplace.

disableDesktopLocalSessions.summary: Disables Desktop Code sessions running on the device, leaving SSH for other hosts and cloud.

disableRemotePreviewScripts.summary: Stops scripts running in the Browser pane HTML previews during SSH and WSL sessions in the desktop app.

enableWorkflows.summary: Enables or disables dynamic workflows, overriding your plan's default.

feedbackDrafts.summary: Controls whether Claude queues feedback drafts for your review.

gatewayInternalNetworks.summary: Allows /login to reach a cloud gateway on public IPv4 addresses your organisation uses internally.

idleCompaction.summary: Prevents Claude Code from compacting lengthy conversations after you step away.

isolatePeerMachines.summary: Asks for your approval before Claude messages your session on another machine.

keybindingFlavor.summary: Obsolete and does nothing; word-editing shortcuts always use readline conventions.

leftArrowOpensAgents.summary: Disables the ← shortcut that sends the session to background and opens agent view.

managedSourcesBehavior.summary: Combine all managed sources you deploy rather than using only the highest-priority one.

maxEffortLevel.summary: Set a maximum effort level for all models or individual models across any provider.

maxProseWidth.summary: Limit how wide Claude's response prose runs in a wide terminal.

modelPicker.summary: Choose the models for the `/model` picker, with your own order and labels.

modelPricing.summary: Show spending using your organisation's contracted rates rather than list prices.

modelSettings.summary: Store an effort setting or auto-compact window for each model, or limit one model's effort.

permissions.additionalDirectories.summary: Let Claude access files outside the current directory.

permissions.allow.summary: Approve the listed tool uses without asking for confirmation.

permissions.ask.summary: Ask for approval before running any tool use you list.

permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDire.summary: Make file tools reject reads outside the working directories in all permission modes.

permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDir.summary: Make `Write`, `Edit`, and `NotebookEdit` reject paths beyond the working directories in all permission modes, except certain Claude Code files.

permissions.defaultMode.summary: Choose the default permission mode used for new sessions.

permissions.deny.summary: Block the listed tool uses, including reads of files containing secrets.

permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting.summary: Block tool calls that would wait for a permission prompt, so an unattended session keeps working.

policyHelper.path.summary: Specify the helper executable that Claude Code runs.

policyHelper.refreshIntervalMs.summary: Run a helper again in the background at a set interval.

policyHelper.timeoutMs.summary: Set the time Claude Code allows for the helper.

prStatusFooterEnabled.summary: Disable the PR review status badge in the prompt footer and its pull request check.

prependPlugins.summary: Run your organisation's mods ahead of every user-installed mod.

promptCacheTtl.summary: Set the prompt cache lifetime used for the main conversation.

promptSuggestionEnabled.summary: Hide the greyed-out prompt suggestions within the input box.

remote.defaultEnvironmentId.summary: Choose the default cloud environment used by claude --cloud. For a self-hosted ccpool_ ID, only user settings, managed settings, and --settings are read.

sandbox.allowAppleEvents.summary: Allow sandboxed commands to send Apple Events on macOS.

sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces.summary: Allow sandboxed commands to make user namespaces in Linux and WSL2.

sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands.summary: Allow Claude to run a blocked command again outside the sandbox, or forbid that.

sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed.summary: Run sandboxed commands without asking for permission.

sandbox.bwrapPath.summary: Point the sandbox to a bubblewrap binary outside `PATH`.

sandbox.credentials.summary: Conceal or obscure credential files and variables within the sandbox.

sandbox.credentials.allowPlaintextInject.summary: Permits masked credentials to be injected into plain HTTP services on test networks you trust.

sandbox.credentials.awsPairs.summary: Combine custom AWS key variables into a single credential used when re-signing AWS requests.

sandbox.credentials.envVars.summary: Remove or hide an environment variable within the sandbox.

sandbox.credentials.files.summary: Prevent or conceal reads of a credential file within the sandbox.

sandbox.credentials.sigv4.summary: Decide if AWS requests using streaming, presigned, or SigV4A are blocked or allowed through.

sandbox.enableWeakerNestedSandbox.summary: Allow the Linux sandbox to run within an unprivileged container.

sandbox.enableWeakerNetworkIsolation.summary: Enable gh, gcloud, and terraform to check TLS through a MITM proxy in the macOS sandbox.

sandbox.enabled.summary: Enable Bash sandboxing for macOS, Linux, and WSL2.

sandbox.excludedCommands.summary: List commands that Claude Code may run outside the sandbox.

sandbox.failIfUnavailable.summary: Stop startup if the sandbox is unavailable rather than running unsandboxed, except on Anthropic-hosted systems.

sandbox.filesystem.summary: Manage the paths that sandboxed commands may read from and write to.

sandbox.filesystem.allowManagedReadPaths.summary: Prevent developers from reopening read paths that your organisation blocked.

sandbox.filesystem.allowRead.summary: Allow reading again within an area that denyRead blocks.

sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite.summary: Specify additional paths where sandboxed commands may write.

sandbox.filesystem.denyRead.summary: Prevent sandboxed commands from reading particular paths.

sandbox.filesystem.denyWrite.summary: Prevent sandboxed commands from writing to particular paths.

sandbox.filesystem.disabled.summary: Disable filesystem isolation but keep network isolation active.

sandbox.ignoreViolations.summary: Suppress violation reports for paths that a command is likely to check.

sandbox.network.summary: Manage the hosts, ports, and sockets that sandboxed commands can access.

sandbox.network.allowAllUnixSockets.summary: Permit sandboxed commands to connect to all Unix sockets.

sandbox.network.allowLocalBinding.summary: Allow sandboxed commands on macOS to listen on ports and connect to localhost.

sandbox.network.allowMachLookup.summary: Allow macOS sandboxed tools such as iOS Simulator or Playwright to access their XPC services.

sandbox.network.allowManagedDomainsOnly.summary: Restrict the network allowlist to only managed settings.

sandbox.network.allowUnixSockets.summary: Specify Unix socket paths that sandboxed commands may use on macOS.

sandbox.network.allowedDomains.summary: Pre-approve domains so sandboxed commands do not prompt for them.

sandbox.network.deniedDomains.summary: Deny domains for sandboxed commands even if an allowed wildcard covers them.

sandbox.network.httpProxyPort.summary: Send sandbox HTTP traffic through a custom proxy on this port.

sandbox.network.socksProxyPort.summary: Send sandbox SOCKS traffic through a custom proxy on this port.

sandbox.network.strictAllowlist.summary: Deny hosts not on the allowlist rather than prompting.

sandbox.network.tlsTerminate.summary: Make the sandbox proxy end TLS so it can inspect HTTPS requests.

sandbox.ripgrep.summary: Use a custom ripgrep binary within the sandbox.

sandbox.socatPath.summary: Set the sandbox proxy to use a socat executable found outside PATH.

skipAutoPermissionPrompt.summary: Skip the initial notice when you enter auto mode yourself instead of through the built-in default.

spellcheck.summary: Mark typos in the prompt box with a spell checker you install.

sshHostCommands.summary: Include SSH connections in the Desktop environment selector when the host is from a command.

strictPluginOnlyCustomization.agents.summary: Stop agents coming from user or project sources.

strictPluginOnlyCustomization.hooks.summary: Stop hooks coming from user or project sources.

strictPluginOnlyCustomization.mcp.summary: Stop MCP servers coming from user or project sources.

strictPluginOnlyCustomization.skills.summary: Stop skills coming from user or project sources.

subagentPromptCacheTtl.summary: Set the prompt cache lifetime for subagents plus other requests beyond the main conversation.

switchModelsOnFlag.summary: Change models automatically or halt when a safety classifier raises a flag.

syncClaudeAiPlugins.summary: Halt loading of plugins that your claude.ai account has enabled and cease downloading new ones.

syncClaudeAiSkills.summary: Halt loading of skills that your claude.ai account has enabled and cease downloading new ones.

taskOutputMaxChars.summary: Removed in v2.1.277 along with the TaskOutput tool it sized.

terminalTitleFromRename.summary: Prevent /rename and --name from altering the terminal tab title.

timeFormat.summary: Display interface times as 12-hour or 24-hour, in UTC, or using a strftime pattern.

timeZone.summary: Display interface times using a time zone that differs from your system's.

ultracode.summary: Let Claude design a workflow for every substantive task without being prompted.

worktree.baseRef.summary: Create new worktrees from either the default remote branch or your local HEAD.

worktree.bgIsolation.summary: Allow background sessions to modify the working copy with no worktree.

worktree.location.summary: Pick the remote machine location where Desktop SSH sessions put their worktrees.

worktree.sparsePaths.summary: In each worktree, check out just the directories you need.

worktree.symlinkDirectories.summary: Instead of duplicating large directories, symlink them into each worktree.
